title: Use of Customized GROW Charts for Detection of SGA in Low Risk Woman.
brief_summary: A prospective randomised control trial to evaluate the effectiveness of customised growth charts for detection of small for gestational age fetus in low risk women, in comparison to conventional standard of care.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

• low risk woman with singleton pregnancy.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant woman with chronic hypertension, Diabetes Mellitus, Autoimmune disorders
* Fetus with chromosomal
* Fetus with structural defects
* Multiple gestation
* Pregnancy with fibroids uterus
* BMI \>35.
condition: Small for Gestational Age at Delivery
